Starting 19:21:42, every PaymentClient.charge call gets ECONNREFUSED on 10.40.42.188:9090. Payment-svc itself logs no errors and health checks pass, so the URL is wrong and payment-svc is fine. Order-service then returns 503s, which is what the gateway reports. The card processor reset at 19:11, the audit_log slow query and the 400 validation error all fall outside this failure path.
The bad PAYMENT_SVC_URL came through a config-service reload. If revision 479 was pushed separately from the release, this would count as a config error rather than a bad deploy.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll order-service back to the previous version and config revision (or set PAYMENT_SVC_URL back to the correct payment-svc port). Then check that /checkout success recovers.
